extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism claims from XML/PDF methods/results and Fig 4-7 captions; claims are bounded to observed membrane binding/apoptosis/xenograft effects.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: K4R2-Nal2-S1 preferentially binds the membrane of PC9 cancer cells relative to HFW cells in fluorescence microscopy assays.
mechanism_claims.limitations: This is cell-line imaging evidence for membrane binding/localization, not a resolved molecular target.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: K4R2-Nal2-S1 treatment activates caspase-3 in PC9 cells but not HFW cells, supporting apoptosis involvement in PC9 cell death.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: K4R2-Nal2-S1 in PC9 and HFW cells
mechanism_claims.limitations: The paper supports apoptosis involvement; it does not identify a direct receptor or upstream molecular target.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: K4R2-Nal2-S1 attenuates PC9 xenograft tumor growth and tumor sections show cleaved PARP staining consistent with apoptosis in vivo.
mechanism_claims.limitations: In vivo efficacy and apoptosis-marker evidence are not promoted to a fully resolved molecular mechanism.

nonblocking_material_limitations.impact: The local paper provides figures and captions, but exact per-point figure quantification was not machine-extracted.
